company.name: Tiriel AI
company.shortDescription: The AI workforce for freight dispatch. Specialized agents that scan, negotiate, coordinate, and close loads, 24/7, in any language.
company.description:
Tiriel is the AI workforce for freight dispatch.

Not dispatch software. A workforce: specialized AI agents, each with one job, one standard, and one boss, the dispatcher. Scout finds the freight across 14+ load boards. Closer negotiates rates with brokers by phone, in parallel, inside rate floors you set. Coordinator runs your drivers in English, Spanish, or whatever language your fleet speaks. Auditor closes the paperwork, files detention and TONU claims, and processes PODs. Analyst learns your operation and makes the team better every week.

Every call is recorded, transcribed, and logged to the load. You direct. They execute.

Built by YCombinator alumni from a family that has run trucks for over 20 years. Live across the United States.

Start with $99 at https://tiriel.ai

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $2,000,000, or 49.44% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $10,647,801 to $17,386,974, a 1.63x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
